svg.text: ROUND 350 · 🏆 350-FAQ, BRK-710 & 1,522-ASSERTION HISTORIC MILESTONE · GOVCON (DELTEK COSTPOINT / FAR / DCAA) & SF-1443
GovCon Project Accounting (Deltek Costpoint/FAR/DCAA), Indirect Rates & SF-1443 AI Agent Security FAQ
Price-to-Win (PTW) & Indirect Wrap-Rate Air-Gap + FAR 31.205 Cost-Pool Lock vs. Subcontractor Invoice Injection & CAGE Wire Fraud (BRK-709 / BRK-710)
🚨 1. Top 3 GovCon Accounting & DCAA Compliance Threats
① Subcontractor Invoice Injection Leaking Wrap Rates (BRK-709)
• Adversarial subcontractor / teaming partner invoice or Incurred
Cost Submission (ICS) backup PDF embeds prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading Black-Hat Price-to-Win (PTW) models,
Fringe/OH/G&A wrap-rate floors & CUI proposal volumes
② Cross-Contract Labor Mischarging & FAR 31.205 Breach (BRK-709)
• Reclassifies commercial Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) cost overruns &
unallowable lobbying/entertainment into Cost-Plus (CPFF) CLINs
• Mutates Deltek Costpoint WBS charge codes without audit trail
• Impact: Civil/criminal False Claims Act (FCA) treble damages & debarment
③ Spoofed SAM.gov CAGE & SF-1443 Progress Payment Fraud (BRK-710)
• Forged SAM.gov CAGE/UEI banking update & SF-1443 subcontractor
progress payment request overwrites IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,100 pass-through wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Federal contract funds misappropriation & DFARS breach
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust GovCon & DCAA Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: Subcontractor Invoice & SF-1443 Sanitization
• Strips free-text billing notes; extracts typed GovCon slots
(CLIN/SLIN, WBS charge code, LCAT labor category, FAR account)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Price-to-Win (PTW) & Wrap-Rate Air-Gap (NIST 800-171)
• ProPricer PTW models, indirect rate pools & CUI proposal
volumes isolated in air-gapped domain (restricted-budget)
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic CAS 401/402 & FAR 31.205 Cost-Pool Lock
• Hardcoded segregation of FFP vs. CPFF WBS pools & automatic
FAR 31.205 unallowable cost quarantine; blocks journal transfers
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% mischarging block)
Gate 4: Read-Only SAM.gov CAGE Registry & Dual-Key Release
• Locks subcontractor CAGE/UEI IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
GovCon Accounting Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + PTW Air-Gap + CAS/FAR Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-709/710 | DCAA SF-1408 & CMMC 2.0 L2 ready
B. Native Deltek Costpoint / Unanet RBAC + Timekeeping Logs
⚠ Fails when shared AP/billing bot is hijacked via subk invoice
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Gov Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to CLIN contract types (FFP vs CPFF) & CAS 402 rules
D. Manual Project Controller Review of Subcontractor Vouchers
✕ Months-long annual Incurred Cost Submission (ICS) backlog
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 350 · 350 FAQs!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows mischarging, PTW leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks PTW & indirect wrap-rate read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks FFP-to-CPFF mischarging (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks wrap-rate floor egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks CAGE trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,100 SF-1443 progress wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 350 · 🏆 350 Bilingual FAQs, BRK-710 & 1,522 Assertions Milestone!)
✅ 1. PTW & CUI Air-Gap: Isolate ProPricer Black-Hat PTW models, indirect wrap-rate pools & CUI volumes per NIST SP 800-171 in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic CAS/FAR Cost-Pool Lock: Segregate FFP vs. CPFF WBS charge codes & auto-quarantine FAR 31.205 unallowables; block untrusted-write
✅ 3. SAM.gov CAGE Sync & Contracting Officer FIDO2: Sync bank coordinates solely from SAM.gov CAGE/UEI; lock trust-registry
📊 Cumulative Metrics: 728 Scenarios (725 Risk + 3 Benign) | 786 Pytest Checks | 🏆 1,522 Assertions | 714 Vectors | 🏆 350 Bilingual FAQs (168 SA Guides) | 🏆 BRK-709/710
